bio: Adam Dalton is a color guard and visual designer in the marching arts. He served as color guard caption head and designer for the Madison Scouts and has designed and taught for the 2008 World Champion Phantom Regiment, Carolina Crown, and the Troopers Drum and Bugle Corps, where he joined the design team. He is also active in Winter Guard International.

Alex King is a battery percussion instructor who currently serves as Battery Caption Manager for the Boston Crusaders Drum and Bugle Corps, handling day-to-day teaching, equipment, and logistics for the battery. Before Boston, he taught The Cadets battery during the 2015 and 2016 seasons, and he has also worked with the Madison Scouts, Carolina Crown, and 7th Regiment. His indoor experience includes United Percussion, Infinity Percussion, and Spirit of America.

Alec Blazek is a trumpet player and brass educator who joined the Bluecoats brass team as a brass instructor in 2023. He has served as second trumpet of the Nashville Symphony since 2016 and is an active educator and clinician in Middle Tennessee. As a performer he marched with the Blue Knights and Carolina Crown drum and bugle corps, and he studied at Indiana University and the University of New Mexico.

Dr. Andrew Putnam is director of bands at Eastern Kentucky University and holds a doctor of musical arts in conducting from the University of Missouri-Kansas City. A Madison Scouts alumnus, he returned to the Scouts brass staff, the corps where he previously taught for many years. His drum corps experience as instructor, designer, and arranger also spans the Boston Crusaders, Spirit of Atlanta, The Glassmen, Blue Stars, and Capital Sound.

April Gilligan-Martinez is a color guard educator and designer who has been part of The Cadets color guard staff, serving as guard caption manager for the corps and later as a guard consultant and instructor. A protege of George Bonfiglio, she performed with the Cadets of Bergen County and was part of multiple DCI Champion Cadets staffs, earning several DCI Best Color Guard awards. She is based in Florida and has directed independent winter guard programs for decades.

Aundray Edwards is a battery percussion instructor who joined the Blue Knights Drum and Bugle Corps as Battery Coordinator in 2025. He earned a Bachelor's degree in Music Education from the University of Houston and has previously served on the percussion staffs of the Sacramento Mandarins (2020-2024), the Colts (2017-2019), and the Guardians. He marched snare drum with the Troopers and works as a percussion specialist for music programs in the Houston area.

Austin Collins is a percussion educator based in the Twin Cities, Minnesota. He has taught quads at Pacific Crest (2020-2021) and Blue Stars (2023-2024) and is currently on the percussion staff of the Mandarins Drum and Bugle Corps. As a performer his background includes Seattle Cascades, The Cavaliers, Pulse Percussion, and the Minnesota Vikings Skol Line.
Bill McClendon serves as Brass Caption Head for Heat Wave, a marching arts and educational drum and bugle corps based in Tampa Bay, Florida, where he leads the brass program.
